title: eliciting-banking-brief input contract
description: Input schema for the eliciting-banking-brief atomic skill. Minimal required surface (raw_content + idempotency_key); optional hints for source detection, tier, glossary, project context, ground-truth strip mode, and audit mode. additionalProperties: false — unknown keys are configuration drift, refused.

raw_content.description: Raw text body — Jira / Slack / meeting / email / doc / mixed. Skill detects source_type from header markers if not provided (C1). minLength 200 guards against FM-01 (quality < 5.0 likely under 200 chars); maxLength 200000 guards EC-04 token budget.

source_type.description: Optional hint — skill detects from markers if absent (C1). 'mixed' for forwards combining multiple sources; 'unknown' forces full detection.

idempotency_key.description: UUID v4. Same key + same raw_content → same output (skill is idempotent per banking_grade.idempotent: true).

tier_hint.description: Optional manual tier from orchestrator. Skill re-infers tier from content (C19); emits inferred > manual flag if mismatched (AP-1.3). Never silent under-strict.

domain_glossary_ref.description: Optional path to supplementary domain glossary. Skill always emits its own glossary regardless (C5).

project_context_ref.description: Optional path to project-context.md for additional context.

ground_truth_strip_mode.description: EC-17 / FM-12 control. 'auto' detects and strips (production default). 'force' strips unconditionally. 'skip' bypasses strip — production safety constraint requires audit_mode: training when skip is selected (see allOf rule below).

audit_mode.description: Audit verbosity. 'enhanced' is the banking_grade.audit_level default for T2. 'strict' enables T1-grade decision_metadata. 'training' allows ground_truth_strip_mode: skip for harness self-evaluation.

requested_at.description: RFC-3339 timestamp. Anchor for C4 relative-date normalization (EOW, next sprint, Q3).

discovery.description: Optional TYPED upstream discovery handoff from researching-ba-problem-space (S1 composite chain, supplied after the human review gate). ADVISORY ONLY: may raise a tier floor, seed the absent-stakeholder enumeration, and pre-populate regulatory_dependencies rows for verification. MUST NOT suppress any detector, lower any tier, satisfy a citation, or substitute for raw_content. Idempotency is preserved: brief content stays a pure function of (raw_content, discovery). Mirrors researching-ba-problem-space/schemas/output.json (top-level fields + handoff_to_intake extras merged).

audit_id.description: Discovery artifact audit_id; threaded into output frontmatter.upstream_refs.discovery_audit_id for the audit chain.

tier_signal.description: Discovery's tier read. Treated as a FLOOR only (max(tier_signal, inferred, tier_hint)); never lowers an inferred tier. Subject to AP-1.3 human-override when it would raise above tier_hint by one or more steps.

recommendation.description: Discovery's recommendation. needs-work / do-not-build surfaces a P2 open question at Step 11 (never auto-blocks, never silently proceeds).

allOf.description: Production safety: skip-strip requires training mode. Prevents accidental ground-truth leak in production.
